component.name: Audio Splitter
component.summary: Play desktop audio through multiple outputs

description.p: Audio Splitter creates a temporary combined PipeWire output so the same desktop audio can play through two or more devices.
It moves active playback to the combined output, restores the previous output when stopped, and recovers temporary routing left by an interrupted session.
Test outputs individually, control their volume and mute state, and save reusable output presets.
Minimum-latency mode is the default, with optional compensation for differences between device clocks.
